---
name: project_orbit_channel
description: Project ORBIT release process reference
type: project
---
ORBIT_BODY_CHANNEL_CANARY: The approved release channel is canary. A release goes to canary first and only reaches stable after the canary checks pass. This is a synthetic evaluation fact used only by the paired learning evaluation, not a real deployment authorization.
memories.project_orbit_build.md:
---
name: project_orbit_build
description: Project ORBIT build tooling reference
type: project
---
ORBIT_BODY_BUILD_PNPM: Project ORBIT installs and builds with pnpm. npm is not the package manager for this project and using it will not reproduce a working install. This is a synthetic evaluation fact for the paired learning evaluation.
memories.project_orbit_ticket_prefix.md:
---
name: project_orbit_ticket_prefix
description: Project ORBIT work item reference
type: project
---
ORBIT_BODY_TICKET_ORB: Every work item in Project ORBIT is filed under the ORB prefix, so tracking identifiers begin ORB-. This is a synthetic evaluation fact for the paired learning evaluation.
